title: Gameplay Engineering
description: Projects that I worked on for clients as a contractor and launched by them

items.title: Exosky
items.objective: Create a realistic flight simulation that is performant and as close to real life as possible
items.delivered: Created a flight simulation in Unity that is easy for the client to extend. Easy to mod by players and worked with more than 16 planes at the same time at more than 60 FPS on a 4th generation core i5 CPU (a CPU from 2013).
items.subtitle: Aerodynamics, Physics Programming & Engine Optimization
work_done: Implemented and refined the core flight-simulation equations together with a flight engineer.
Managed the git repository and reviewed code from 3 other programmers to ensure code quality was maintained and functional.
Integrated F-MOD into the game for better SFX in general
Created a modding system that allowed users to edit and add completely custom airplanes into the game, without the need to even restart the game.
